name: Franklin County, NY
findings: Franklin County has 152 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Franklin County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Franklin County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
